_doc: Authored connector of the composite map (ARCH_OPTIONS SC1; P0-029 stitch bench draft). Control points are world metres (east +X, north -Z, origin at the centre of the layout C map box). The first and the last point lie on the boundary ports named in from and to. Built by the lane model of tools/bake/roads/ through tools/bake/stitch/connectors.ts. Not signed off.
name: Ring Road
standsFor: Mahatma Gandhi Marg (the Ring Road) on the west bank of the Yamuna from the Red Fort down to ITO, then Tilak Marg to the C-Hexagon
notes: Runs down the river bank, 60 m or more from the water, then swings south west to India Gate. In layout C the ITO district sits on this arc; the bench has no ITO district, so the arc runs through filler.
